STANDARD RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

PARTIES & PREMISES
This Lease Agreement is made on October 15, 2026, between Landlord: Dawit Haile, and Tenant: Bethlehem Tadesse.
The Landlord agrees to rent to the Tenant the residential apartment located at: Apartment 3C, Cameroon Street, Bole Subcity, Addis Ababa, Ethiopia.

LEASE TERM & RENT
The term of this lease shall be for twelve (12) calendar months, commencing on November 1, 2026, and terminating on October 31, 2027.
The monthly rent shall be 48,000 ETB (Ethiopian Birr), payable in advance on or before the first (1st) day of each calendar month via direct bank transfer to Landlord's designated account.

SECURITY DEPOSIT & UTILITIES

SECURITY DEPOSIT
Upon signing this Agreement, Tenant shall pay a security deposit of 96,000 ETB (equivalent to two months' rent).
The security deposit shall be held by Landlord and returned in full within thirty (30) days of vacating the premises, subject to physical inspection for damages beyond normal wear and tear.

UTILITY RESPONSIBILITIES
Rent includes: Monthly municipal water service, 24/7 security guard, and shared backup generator fuel charges.
Tenant is solely responsible for: Private internet subscription, interior electricity consumed via personal meter, and satellite TV service.

MAINTENANCE, RESTRICTIONS & TERMINATION

MAINTENANCE OBLIGATIONS
Landlord is responsible for structural repairs, plumbing lines, and external building maintenance.
Tenant shall be responsible for routine interior upkeep, light fixtures, and any damage caused by negligence.

TERMINATION & NOTICE
Either party may terminate this agreement upon providing sixty (60) days advance written notice.
Subleasing is strictly prohibited without the express prior written consent of the Landlord.
